Hello all,

This is the beginning of my participation in this great community. I have been around for a long time, it is just recently that I felt I could finally participate and surely learn much much more. What kept me away was the multitude of information required to grasp and then the ability to project it for myself. Also, during my silent journey in RTM I got lost a little while reading along some posts. I must have started and restarted over 5 times until I began to write down everything on a notebook and everything sank in... not everything but almost

So I hope this is going to be the beginning of a great journey ahead:)

So here is a trade I took earlier that is still running... Ideally I was waiting for price to get into H4 supply but it turned at around 134.153 S turned R.

Entry was based off of the 30M after the engulf of the swing lows and demand; at the FL highlighted in grey as price was CPing into it. All comments are appreciated:)

Edit: trade closed manually... details coming up

The closing of EJ

The idea of closing started when the diamond was forming and broke higher on the M5 chart at the 2nd LL of the qm. A 2nd reaction was expected at the zone of the flag's FTR, however it engulfed and gave the HH of the possible qm formation.

Dropping into M1 price came back down and respected FTR1 to the pip which also was qm level at M15 fresh demand. Had it engulfed it (FTR1) I would have probably taken a bigger chance waiting.... but as price drove higher breaching and then closing above the last FTR on the way down I decided to close out for app 4.6 pips.

I think it was a good trade as I almost had no drawdown apart from the spread at entry... the rest is history:) Maybe next time

PS: I have no clue whether I am talking RTM or I am being delusional.... In case of the latter I might have to disappear again n get into studying harder... In the meantime I will wait for a kind member to reply...

Have a great weekend!

Missing out on a well thought out trade is good for you in a way. It gives you the drive to take all the next ones that come along, and there are lots of them:)

Pucci,

I am sure there are lots of people lurking in the background trying to get to grips with the information. Some are put off by intimidation or purely do not want to look silly.

Well i will tell you that you were brave to step forward like you have, but only brave for a moment, because you realised that once you stepped in, it wasn't so bad at all!

That is very much the truth and i was exactly the same. It is your mind, holding you back from all the good stuff in life.

You have taken a giant leap forward and now you will start to see things unfold before your eyes. Simply the best and only way is to put your charts in the forum ask questions and puzzle things out.

It is much more powerful than just looking and lurking...................you have just taken the "FAST TRACK" to the truth.

You are a step closer to all those dreams you had and the great possibilities trading can bring.

Whilst you are learning, you may experience frustrations, that is all natural.

IF replied when you said you had found an entry but chickened out.

You know what, i remember the days when i just couldn't see the pattern or the trade opp.

Think of it this way...................you can now see it, where you couldn't.

Now practice with home work and take snapshots of patterns and mark up your charts like a story of price. The more you do this, the more patterns you will so and confidence will take over for you to place a trade.

I think you have got off to a good start...........you know what you are looking for.

Well Done!

Warren

Warren wrote: Pucci,

Warren

I didn't look right through you, i would be some kind of god if i did. I just remember standing back and looking at myself! You see everything you guys are going through older members have been there. So i know what helped me and others, i am just trying to shorten your learning curve.

OK, this is what i want you to do, find somewhere quiet or go for a walk. YOU MUST BE ALONE! Think about these things.

1. When you look at a chart can you see the patterns discussed here, do they stand out as if they are magnified or 3D, your eye is drawn to them?

2. Are you prepared to keep marking these charts up and analyse before, during and after the move?

3. do you under understand that this frustration is just part of the PROCESS. It passes with every aha moment?

4. Realize that the only difference between you and Elite trader is TIME.................yes, it is the only thing that stands in your way.

5. RELAX and enjoy the journey, beating yourself up will only unbalance your emotions and we know that is no good for trading or learning.

6. Understand that you are unlearning all the tripe you have been fed about trading before now, only then can you learn.......RETRAIN THE BRAIN!

7. repeat after me................. I AM USING THE RIGHT APPROACH.................I AM USING THE RIGHT APPROACH. FEEL THE PASSION, FEEL THE PAIN.

Hey Guys,

I have the urge to let some steam out and come clean… I just feel like this is the right place to share since I know I am going to be sticking around until I either make it or make it:)

A little history about me,

I have been at this business for more years than I care to admit openly (cause you’ll guess my age ), let’s just say it’s been over a decade I am working on becoming consistently successful in this path I have chosen for myself.

I had a career in a very demanding industry and through hard work I even managed to carve my own partnership until many years later I felt I wasn’t giving trading the attention it required so I closed shop and took it onto myself to make a living out of trading. I thought I would force myself to learn swimming or drown. That was 4 and half years ago… I had ups and downs as one would expect.

Like so many, I too have gone down the indicator avenue and back up again until coming back full circle. I have had a lot of success at times and when my confidence grew I lost almost all in just a few trades. Suddenly the system I had built for myself that had generated 330% ROE in 6 months (with almost no drawdown) cost me 275% in 7 trades. I’ll let you imagine what that did to my psyche… I then couldn’t look at a chart for months on end without getting panic attacks; I had anxiety, depression and sleepless nights coupled with nightmares of market crashes (or rallies for that matter) that sucked the life out of me while of course being against me.

The next phase was filled with research, learning Supply and Demand and of course after demoing for a few weeks, I jumped right back into live, losing the rest of my initial equity and much much more. It seemed every level I traded failed! It was as if there was this dark cloud of bad luck hanging over my head. Needless to say, I was devouring all Red’s material, followed PIE, then registered with AG until I came here because IF was anyway my favorite all along (this is no flattery, it’s true). I lurked for over a year in here absorbing the material and getting lost often along the way too; traded my new discovered knowledge only to lose more.

I think I am under pressure because I need to make a living out of this. I am not giving up, even though lately I had to move back in with my family because I could not sustain the expenses of my own place.

The reason for all the above is really because I caught myself lately looking into snake oil again. Also, I want this to be a new beginning for me through this journal. So I am holding myself accountable in front of all you good people on here.

That’s it for now; I have to get back to studying

its really good you decide to share your story, i suppose it will help you if you read it and see the turning points in it. the only advice i can give is that any kind of stress in your life will reflect in your trading, i think you know that too well by now.

so better stabilize your life first while also working on your demo (or sim) trading. forget about live till as IF says "you are bored of wins in demo" find your favorite setup and learn it inside out, so well that you are able to teach it. journal everything, either offline or here and even plan your study as Aaron (DT1) suggested. but most of all find balance again, or else you will be running all over the place like a headless chicken in the first bad card dealt. i wish you every success

Appreciate you being brave enough to step forward Pucci and share you past trials with everyone, it can't have been easy. You'll find there are many more similar hidden stories on here. Hopefully clearing out your trading locker in the open air will be the begining of a better trading future. When I'm looking to make a fresh trading start I usually move my trading desk around, as I wouldn't have the bottle to air my trading soul in public. Thankfully since finding IF and RTM I haven't yet had to move my desk:), though I have a ways to go yet on the final implementation of what I have learned from IF's generous sharing.

There will come a time when you'll find you are not learning anything new and then your work needs to shift to applying what you have learned. My time is now spent on FT, honing my skills and building my confidence. Building confidence is key here. I can see it clearly in the kids I coach, with each pat on the back, each "well done", they grow in confidence, they improve in their heads so they improve on the field and this in turn builds more confidence. A confident person will always perform better. Doubting your analysis and your entries and exits is no way to trade.

I know that you were not really looking for advice here but just venting and clearing the way for a fresh start, maybe I am just doing a bit of releasing of my own:). Sure it's easy to talk when your amongst friends.
